audience: refrigeration and climate installers who keep customer records in Climatools

useCases.title: Find a business customer and its address
useCases.text: Search the companies by name or client number. Open one company to read its address and tags.

useCases.title: Find a private contact by e-mail
useCases.text: Search the private contacts by e-mail, name or client number. Open one contact to read its address and tags.

useCases.title: Review installations and refrigerants
useCases.text: List the installations with their brand, model and refrigerant circuits. Look up the refrigerants that Climatools knows.

useCases.title: Add a new business customer
useCases.text: Search for the company first to avoid a duplicate. Then create the company with its name and address.

useCases.title: Add a new private contact
useCases.text: Search the private contacts first. Then create the contact with its last name and address.
